appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn, primarily in the library
appearances.notable_actions: Leads the Emond's Field group down the back stairs to the library to avoid the common room; introduces Nynaeve, Perrin, and Egwene to Loial; tells of his encounter with Queen Morgase, Elayne, and Gawyn in the Palace gardens; reluctantly reveals the dreams involving Ba'alzamon along with Mat and Perrin; almost mentions the name Logain but catches himself; realizes Moiraine might want to use one of them as a false Dragon
appearances.demeanor: anxious, subdued, sweating; disturbed by Perrin's glowing eyes; wants no more adventure; relieved to have his friends together again but worried about Mat and the dagger; suspicious and uncertain about Moiraine's intentions

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn, library
appearances.notable_actions: First to speak when they sit down, asking Loial about the stedding as havens; tells of meeting Tinkers and Whitecloaks; reveals the story the Tinkers told about the Aiel and the Eye of the World; brings up Ba'alzamon's name and insists they must tell Moiraine about the dreams; recounts what Ba'alzamon said; mentions being chosen and Ba'alzamon laughing; recalls the name Raolin Darksbane; says he has 'already found his protection' in a resigned tone
appearances.demeanor: resigned and calm despite everyone else's worry; his face is smooth rather than creased with worry like the others; deliberate in speech; has bruises on his face; strangely calm yellow eyes that glow in shadow

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn; brought down from upstairs by Moiraine; in the library with the group
appearances.notable_actions: Appears recovered from his sickness; apologizes for acting oddly and says he doesn't remember much after Whitebridge; still has the dagger tucked in his belt and touches it absentmindedly; joins in the banter and laughter; reveals Ba'alzamon said the Amyrlin Seat would try to use them like she used Davian and other names; recalls some of what Ba'alzamon said in dreams; says he doesn't want Ba'alzamon inside his head again
appearances.demeanor: hesitant and uncertain at first, with an uneasy look toward Moiraine; returns to his old swagger and grin once reassured; sounds stiff when saying he doesn't want to remember; reluctant but willing to share about the dreams

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn, library
appearances.notable_actions: Introduced to Loial by Rand; tells Mat that no one blames him for what he did while affected by the dagger; comforts Egwene by putting her arms around her when Egwene cries; scolds Moiraine for frightening the boys with talk of the Dark One
appearances.demeanor: emotional with tears in her eyes when Mat is well, but smiling; protective of the young people from Emond's Field; sharp-tongued toward Moiraine when she feels the Aes Sedai is being needlessly frightening; looks as if she wants to cry when hearing about the Dark One's influence

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn, library
appearances.notable_actions: Introduced to Loial by Rand; joins in the excited questions to Loial; mentions the Aiel story the Tinkers told; asks in a neutral voice who Elayne is; cries softly when hearing about Ba'alzamon and the Dark One's influence on the boys
appearances.demeanor: excited at first when meeting Loial and hearing stories; becomes subdued and fearful when learning about the dreams and the Dark One; possibly jealous or concerned about Elayne; emotional and crying by the end, comforted by Nynaeve

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn; brings Mat down from upstairs to the library
appearances.notable_actions: Brings Mat downstairs with her hand on his shoulder, watching him carefully; explains that she has cleansed the taint from Mat but cannot fully separate him from the dagger without killing him; tells Rand the dagger's call has been contained; explains the Dark One's power and how the boys can resist; reveals there are twenty Red Ajah Aes Sedai in Caemlyn; listens to Loial's story about the dying man and the Eye of the World; hears the boys' confession about Ba'alzamon in their dreams; shows anger at herself for not asking about dreams sooner; explains about Dreamwalkers and the Forsaken; decides they must travel via the Ways to reach the Eye of the World quickly; asks Loial if he knows the Ways and can guide them to Fal Dara/Mafal Dadaranell
appearances.demeanor: careful and watchful of Mat; confident in her healing; serious and strategic when planning; shows a flash of anger when realizing she should have asked about dreams earlier; thoughtful and calculating when hearing multiple warnings about the Eye; dry and somewhat curt when dealing with Loial's verbosity; speaks of being frightened herself by the implications

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn; briefly in the library before being sent away by Moiraine
appearances.notable_actions: Escorts Moiraine and Mat downstairs; sent by Moiraine to ensure they are not taken unaware; vanishes from the room silently
appearances.demeanor: watchful and vigilant as always; silent and efficient

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn, library
appearances.notable_actions: Reading on the couch with a cat on his stomach when the group arrives; stands and bows formally when introduced; tells about the stedding and his travels; relates the story of the dying man who came to Stedding Shangtai twenty years ago with a warning about the Eye of the World; taught songs to the Tuatha'an; asks Moiraine about the Eye of the World and whether the Dark One can blind it; shows enthusiasm about ta'veren and the Pattern; is asked by Moiraine if he knows the Ways and can guide them; reluctantly admits he knows the Ways and the path to Mafal Dadaranell but emphatically refuses, saying they will all die or be swallowed by the Shadow if they enter the Ways
appearances.demeanor: welcoming and formal when greeting the newcomers; takes their gaping at him in stride; glad to talk at length about stedding and his travels; thoughtful when asking about the dying man's tale; brightened by the prospect of observing ta'veren; abashed when told to be brief; becomes emphatic and almost thunderous when refusing to take them into the Ways, showing genuine fear and concern
